name: Residence Massacre
desc:
Coming home from work, you didn't expect to receive a message from the government. Even less did you expect having to defend your home from a bloodthirsty creature...

If you're new, this game can be very difficult. Death is part of the experience. 

Shift/L3 to sprint
F/X/Square for flashlight

Mobile/PC/CONSOLE Support

Exploiting and willingly playing with exploiters will result in a permanent ban. 
Bug abusing and promoting bug abuse is punishable. This includes all users associated with it.
